answer: An agent economy counters Sybil attacks by linking identities to hydrostatic pressure telemetry gathered during an autonomous marine voyage. Verifiers corroborate reported depth cycles against local ocean tide oscillations using a hollow piezoresistive pressure cell. An adversary must manufacture and operate discrete underwater hardware per identity rather than multiplexing virtual nodes. However, unpredictable storm surges can disrupt baseline readings, falsely invalidating honest agents.
